# Draft:Wargrave (band)

----
Wargrave was a South African thrash metal band from Cape Town, South Africa. The band began as a traditional thrash metal act and later incorporated elements of technical death metal and melodic death metal. The band was active in the South African Metal scene until disbanding in 2017.
Recognition and awards
In 2016, Wargrave won the South African Metal Music Award (SAMMA) for Best Thrash Metal Band and was runner-up for Album of the Year for their debut album Suffering the Void.
Notable performances
Wargrave performed at several prominent South African metal festivals, including Metal4Africa’s Summerfest and Winterfest events, as well as Rock the River festival appearances in the early 2010s.
